messages.content: Selamat pagi. Saya Faridah dari tariff product team. Hari ni saya nak buat draft tariff baru — name 'Postpaid Pro Family 2026 H2', segment postpaid_family, effective 1 July 2026 sampai 31 Dec 2026. Boleh tolong cipta draft dahulu?
Selamat pagi Puan Faridah. Baik, saya cipta draft tariff sekarang.

function.arguments: {"name": "Postpaid Pro Family 2026 H2", "segment": "postpaid_family", "effective_period": {"starts_at": "2026-07-01T00:00:00+08:00", "ends_at": "2026-12-31T23:59:59+08:00"}, "description": "Family postpaid plan H2 2026 with shareable data and primary+supp line structure.", "base_currency": "MYR", "plan_structure": {"primary_line_monthly_myr": 159.00, "supp_line_monthly_myr": 49.00, "max_supp_lines": 4, "shareable_data_gb": 80, "shared_voice_minutes": 500, "unlimited_intra_family_calls": true}, "metadata": {"created_by": "product-team-faridah", "product_code": "PPFAM-2026-H2"}}

messages.content: {"tariff_id": "tariff-ppfam-2026h2", "tariff_version_id": "v1.0", "status": "draft", "created_at": "2026-05-21T09:01:11+08:00", "name": "Postpaid Pro Family 2026 H2"}
Draft `tariff-ppfam-2026h2` v1.0 dicipta. Sebelum kita ke QA, mahu saya tarik tariff version untuk semakan, dan jalankan validasi statik sekali untuk pastikan tiada masalah konfigurasi?
Yes both in parallel.
Baik Puan.

messages.name: run_tariff_static_validation
messages.content: {"validation_report_id": "tval-rep-77019", "tariff_id": "tariff-ppfam-2026h2", "tariff_version_id": "v1.0", "summary": {"total_rules": 24, "passed": 22, "warnings": 1, "errors": 1}, "issues": [{"severity": "error", "code": "TAX-MISSING-SST", "description": "Supplementary line at RM 49 does not specify SST 6% inclusion flag."}, {"severity": "warning", "code": "EFF-OVERLAP-SOFT", "description": "Postpaid family promo overlaps with existing tariff-ppfam-2025h2 by 1 day (30 Jun)."}]}

Puan:

- Tariff v1.0 confirmed.
- Validation: 22/24 pass; **1 error** (TAX-MISSING-SST: supp line RM 49 missing SST 6% flag); **1 warning** (1-day overlap with H1 2026 tariff).

The SST error must be fixed before QA. Mahu saya buka komen kepada team untuk update SST flag, dan dalam masa yang sama buka satu QA session dengan test plan yang sesuai untuk family plan?

Yes — tetapi sebelum QA, snapshot dulu v1.0 ni untuk record. Pastu buka komen dan buka QA session. Test plan: 5 scenarios: solo primary, primary+1 supp, primary+4 supp, data exhaustion, voice exhaustion.
Baik Puan, tiga tindakan serentak.

Puan:

- Snapshot `snap-ppfam-v1` saved (312 KB).
- Comment to tariff-config-team posted (3 emails sent).
- QA session `qasess-tariff-44091` opened.

Now let me add the 5 test cases to the session. Mahu Puan saya tambah sample billing events untuk setiap scenario, atau cukup dengan placeholder test case definitions buat masa ini?
Tambah sample billing events untuk setiap scenario. Test data: 1 primary line, 1 with 1 supp, 1 with 4 supp, 1 with 100GB data usage, 1 with 700 minutes voice.
Baik Puan.

5 test cases ditambah. Team tariff-config baru sahaja confirm v1.1 dengan SST flag siap. Mahu saya execute QA session sekarang menggunakan v1.0 (sementara v1.1 propagate), atau tunggu v1.1?
Execute pakai v1.0 dulu untuk baseline. Nanti kita re-run guna v1.1 untuk regression.
Baik Puan, executing QA session.

Puan, 4/5 pass. **1 fail**: tc-voice-exhaustion - voice overage rate ditetapkan 0.15 MYR/min tetapi rate sheet kata 0.12 MYR/min. Ini perlu dibetulkan. Sebagai investigation, mahu saya simulate billing untuk satu account real (dummy untuk test) untuk verify, dan attach evidence rate sheet rasmi?
Yes simulate untuk account dummy acc-test-fam-001. Use 700 voice mins, expect 24 MYR overage. Attach rate sheet pdf URL https://product.telco.my/rates/ppfam-2026h2-v1.0.pdf
Baik Puan, kedua-dua serentak.

Puan, simulation confirm:

- Rate dalam draft = **0.15 MYR/min** (salah)
- Rate dalam ratesheet rasmi = **0.12 MYR/min**
- Discrepancy: RM 6 setiap akaun dengan 200 min overage.

Ini perlu dibetulkan dalam tariff sebelum approval. Mahu saya buka approval request kepada finance lead dengan butiran ini, dengan condition: tunggu fix rate dahulu?
Yes raise approval — Finance Lead Encik Tan, condition fix voice overage rate to 0.12 sebelum boleh deploy.
Mohon tunggu sebentar.

Approval `appr-tariff-77019` raised to Encik Tan, due tomorrow 9:08 AM. Tariff config team baru update v1.1 (fixed both SST and voice rate). Mahu saya record decision bila Encik Tan respond, dan deploy v1.1 ke environment qa untuk regression run?
Yes — Encik Tan dah respond approved with the condition fixed in v1.1. Record his decision. Lepas tu deploy v1.1 ke qa environment.
Baik Puan.

Yes rollback dahulu untuk safety. Reason: rating_engine_503_transient. Pastu kita akan tunggu admin restart selesai sebelum re-trigger.

Puan:

- Audit log: 4 events (create -> QA complete -> approval -> rollback).
- Daily health probe `sched-ppfam-44091` aktif, first run esok 7 AM.

Ringkasan akhir sesi:
- Draft `tariff-ppfam-2026h2` v1.0 dicipta -> validation found SST + rate issues -> v1.1 dengan pembetulan -> QA 4/5 pass -> approval Encik Tan diterima -> deploy ke qa fail (rating engine transient) -> rollback selesai
- Snapshot, evidence ratesheet, dan daily probe semua dalam place

Mahu Puan saya kongsi link snapshot untuk team referensi?
No thanks, cukup. Saya akan retry deploy bila admin clear rating engine issue. Terima kasih.
Sama-sama Puan Faridah. Sila hubungi semula bila ingin re-deploy v1.1 - kami akan setia membantu. Selamat pagi.
